status: PIPELINE VALIDATION AND LABEL SANITY. Not the A2 test - that requires a preregistration and multiple days, and has not been run.

URA_SISA_index.reading: The operator's own error bound, shipped FREE inside the student's input, and round 2 flagged it as the likely dominant dumb baseline. It rank-correlates at -0.077 - essentially nothing, and with the wrong sign. On this one day it is NOT the strong baseline it was feared to be.

age_of_data.reading: Also near zero, BUT THIS IS NOT A CLEAN READING and must not be quoted as one. The selection rule used here picks the ephemeris with the closest toe, which emulates a receiver that always holds the freshest data - so age barely varies (almost no samples beyond +1 hour) and its effect cannot be observed. Physics says broadcast error MUST grow with age of data. A proper test requires emulating a receiver that uses the ephemeris actually available at time t. Recorded as COULD NOT VERIFY rather than as a null result.

per_satellite_identity.reading: THE REAL DUMB BASELINE, and it was not the one round 2 named. Satellite identity alone separates G28 at 0.300 m std from G21 at 12.592 m. A per-satellite historical mean is trivially available and will capture a large share of the variance. The A2 test must beat THAT, not URA.

validation.clock: VALIDATED AS REAL, not as small. Per-satellite residual std ranges from G28 at 0.300 m - which proves the pipeline is correct - to G21 at 12.592 m and G07 at 9.230 m. Inspecting the time series shows those large residuals are SMOOTH RAMPS, roughly 8 m/hour on G21, not noise. That is genuine broadcast clock-prediction drift on specific satellites, and it is exactly the thing a correction service would pay to anticipate.
validation.orbit: VALIDATED. Radial 1.386, along 0.863, cross 0.520 m RMS over 8,640 healthy epochs.
validation.unhealthy_excluded: records with health != 0 are dropped; G01 and G22 carried health=63

what_this_does_not_establish: It is not the A2 test. No learned model has been trained and no baseline has been scored.
One day, one constellation (GPS), one product line (ESA final). No seed sweep, no multi-day split.
The age-of-data reading is confounded by the ephemeris selection rule and is COULD NOT VERIFY.
SISRE here uses the standard global-average weights and removes a per-satellite median bias, which a receiver cannot observe. Different conventions give different absolute numbers.
what_was_built: GPS broadcast-ephemeris propagation (IS-GPS-200 user algorithm), precise orbit and clock parsing, and signal-in-space ranging error. tools/gnss/ephem.py.
